title: Tiny, cute aeroplane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- soft glow halo behind plane -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='38' ry='20' fill='#1a3a5c' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- main fuselage body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='30' ry='9' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <!-- fuselage lighter belly shade -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='28' ry='5' fill='#81d4fa'/>
  <!-- top shadow strip for contrast -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='26' ry='4' fill='#29b6f6'/>
  <!-- tail fin (vertical stabilizer) -->
  <path d='M22 50 L16 28 L30 28 L34 50 Z' fill='#ff8a65'/>
  <!-- tail fin highlight -->
  <path d='M23 48 L18 30 L28 30 L31 48 Z' fill='#ffab91'/>
  <!-- horizontal tail wing -->
  <path d='M20 52 L6 58 L10 62 L28 56 Z' fill='#ff7043'/>
  <path d='M20 48 L8 42 L12 38 L30 46 Z' fill='#ff7043'/>
  <!-- main wings (both sides, behind body) -->
  <path d='M42 50 L28 68 L36 72 L54 54 Z' fill='#ff8a65'/>
  <path d='M58 50 L72 68 L64 72 L46 54 Z' fill='#ff8a65'/>
  <!-- wing highlights -->
  <path d='M43 51 L31 66 L37 69 L52 55 Z' fill='#ffccbc'/>
  <path d='M57 51 L69 66 L63 69 L48 55 Z' fill='#ffccbc'/>
  <!-- cockpit window -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='47' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#e1f5fe'/>
  <!-- cockpit window shine -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='46' rx='2.5' ry='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- nose tip -->
  <circle cx='79' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ffab91'/>
  <!-- tiny propeller hub -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='50' r='4' fill='#ffd54f'/>
  <!-- propeller blades -->
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='42' rx='2' ry='6' fill='#ffee58'/>
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='58' rx='2' ry='6' fill='#ffee58'/>
  <!-- little smile on face area near cockpit -->
  <path d='M62 53 Q65 56 68 53' stroke='#0277bd' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- two dot eyes -->
  <circle cx='61' cy='49' r='1.5' fill='#01579b'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='49' r='1.5' fill='#01579b'/>
  <!-- windows along side -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='50' r='2' fill='#b3e5fc'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='50' r='2' fill='#b3e5fc'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='50' r='2' fill='#b3e5fc'/>
  <!-- tiny clouds -->
  <ellipse cx='18' cy='76' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#90caf9' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='74' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#90caf9' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='24' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#90caf9' opacity='0.4'/>
</svg>
